transitions.name: State button
transitions.description: Save, progress, and confirmation in one button.
transitions.detail: A button that carries the action through progress and completion. Use the demo replay to study the state changes.
transitions.when: Save and submit actions that already have pending/success/error state.
transitions.integration: Use the host save callback through onAction. Preserve validation, disabled state, and retry rules. Never use the simulation as real persistence.

transitions.name: Sliding tabs
transitions.description: Switch views with a selection that follows your lead.
transitions.detail: A shared selection surface follows the active tab. Designed for a small set of modes or views.
transitions.when: A small set of modes, filters, or views with an existing selected value.
transitions.integration: Connect value/onValueChange and supply items. Keep each tab associated with its existing panel.
transitions.props: items, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, ariaLabel, speed, radius, className, style

transitions.name: Morphing menu
transitions.description: Turn a compact trigger into a menu of actions.
transitions.detail: A trigger and its options share one visual surface. Keep the menu close to the action it supports.
transitions.when: A compact action trigger opening a nearby set of commands.
transitions.integration: Supply actions with onSelect callbacks and a label. Preserve menu focus and keyboard behavior. In an existing Radix menu, adapt the surface motion instead of replacing the primitive.
transitions.props: actions, label, speed, radius, className, style

transitions.name: Text swap
transitions.description: Keep changing statuses readable and connected.
transitions.detail: Soft directional transitions for short statuses and labels. Keep essential information readable and announce changes appropriately.
transitions.when: Short status messages that change as an operation progresses.
transitions.integration: Connect the status index with value; supply statuses with text and icons. Keep a single polite announcement for a meaningful change.
transitions.props: statuses, value, speed, radius, className, style

transitions.name: Expanding search
transitions.description: Open a search field without leaving your place.
transitions.detail: A compact search trigger opens into an editable field, with deliberate focus handling and an easy return.
transitions.when: Compact search or filter controls that need more space on focus.
transitions.integration: Connect value/onValueChange and optionally open/onOpenChange. Only direct interaction moves focus; external disclosure updates and controlled replay preserve it. onSearch submits the query. Supply actual searchable items or replace demonstration result rendering.
transitions.props: items, open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, onSearch, placeholder, speed, radius, className, style

transitions.name: Toast stack
transitions.description: Layer notifications without taking over the screen.
transitions.detail: Transient feedback stacks and settles as notifications arrive or leave. Preview messages are demonstration data.
transitions.when: A notification system with multiple recent messages.
transitions.integration: Adapt the stack geometry to the existing toast provider. This reference uses a local Preview toast control; preserve the host provider's lifecycle, expiry, pause, live region, and dismissal semantics.
transitions.props: title, description, replayKey, speed, radius, className, style

transitions.name: Copy feedback
transitions.description: Copy a command. Confirm it right where you clicked.
transitions.detail: A clipboard action with precise state feedback. Copy succeeds only after the browser accepts the write.
transitions.when: Copying a command, URL, identifier, or other text.
transitions.integration: Pass the exact text. Confirm only after the clipboard write succeeds and preserve the manual fallback.

transitions.name: Rolling counter
transitions.description: Give changing quantities a sense of direction.
transitions.detail: Digits move in the direction of the value change. Useful for quantities, totals, and compact numerical adjustments.
transitions.when: Adjustable integer quantities, totals, or compact counters.
transitions.integration: Connect value/onValueChange and the allowed range. The reference supports 0–999; adapt digit count explicitly for larger ranges or signed values.
transitions.props: value, defaultValue, onValueChange, min, max, label, speed, radius, className, style

transitions.name: Accordion
transitions.description: Reveal details with a coordinated height and content transition.
transitions.detail: Disclosure with a continuous height change and a coordinated content reveal. Preserve the relationship between heading and content.
transitions.when: Expandable help, preferences, and short supporting details.
transitions.integration: Supply items and connect value/onValueChange if controlled. Keep the heading/panel relationship and make closed interactive content inert.
transitions.props: items, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, speed, radius, className, style

transitions.name: Icon morph
transitions.description: Connect open and close with the same SVG strokes.
transitions.detail: Three SVG strokes draw together and become a close icon. One continuous motion preserves the shape through rapid reversals.
transitions.when: A menu or panel toggle that needs a clear change of state.
transitions.integration: Connect pressed/onPressedChange to the actual panel state. Keep the stable label and existing focus management. Forward aria-controls to the panel and preserve host dismissal behavior. Replay changes only the icon, never the application state.
transitions.props: pressed, defaultPressed, onPressedChange, label, labels, disabled, buttonRef, native button attributes, speed, radius, className, style

transitions.name: Inline edit
transitions.description: Rename in place. Keep the context.
transitions.detail: A label opens into an editable surface, then returns to its accepted value. Save and cancel stay within the same place.
transitions.when: Project names, short titles, and metadata that can be edited in place.
transitions.integration: Connect value and onCommit to the actual update. Resolve only after saving succeeds, reject on failure, and update the controlled value after acceptance. Optional validate returns a readable error. Enter saves; Escape or Cancel discards an idle draft. During a pending save, Escape or Close only hides the editor: the operation continues and new commits remain blocked until settlement. Composition input never submits early. The preview changes local data only. Replay must not save or move focus.
transitions.props: value, defaultValue, onCommit, validate, label, speed, radius, className, style

transitions.name: Animated list
transitions.description: Add, remove, and rearrange without losing your place.
transitions.detail: Stable items move into their new positions as the list changes. Content stays sharp while the surrounding space adjusts.
transitions.when: Changing file lists, search results, queues, or selected items.
transitions.integration: Supply items with unique stable IDs and React content. The host owns insertion, removal, sorting, and focus after its own commands. Keep business actions in the host; this recipe supplies list semantics and motion. Exiting rows leave the focus order immediately. Replay never changes host data or repeats actions.
transitions.props: items, emptyState, ariaLabel, speed, radius, className, style

transitions.name: Selection toolbar
transitions.description: Actions take shape around your selection.
transitions.detail: A compact selection count expands into contextual actions. The surface follows the current selection and folds away when it clears.
transitions.when: Bulk actions for selected files, messages, or table rows.
transitions.integration: Connect count, actions, and onClear to host-owned selection. Each action calls its real onSelect operation; pending and failure follow its promise. The host clears or updates selection after acceptance. Supply returnFocusRef for focused controls that disappear; unrelated focus stays put. Preview archive and restore affect local sample files only. Replay never calls actions.
transitions.props: count, actions, onClear, returnFocusRef, ariaLabel, speed, radius, className, style

transitions.name: Play / pause
transitions.description: One shape, two states. Continuous in both directions.
transitions.detail: Two filled SVG paths reshape a play symbol into pause bars. A shared spring keeps their geometry connected through interruption and reversal.
transitions.when: Play and pause controls for video, audio, or user-controlled animation.
transitions.integration: Connect playing to the actual media or animation state, and onPlayingChange to a playback request. Update state from real play, pause, and ended events; handle rejected play promises in the host. The button does not operate media itself. Supply accessible Play/Pause labels and keep native keyboard behavior. The optional local preview is a finite animation, not an audio or video player. Replay changes only the icon, never playback state or callbacks.
transitions.props: playing, defaultPlaying, onPlayingChange, labels, disabled, buttonRef, native button attributes, speed, radius, className, style

transitions.name: Confirm action
transitions.description: Make room for a deliberate second click.
transitions.detail: A compact action unfolds into confirmation and cancellation in the same surface. The operation begins only after explicit confirmation, and feedback follows its real outcome.
transitions.when: Confirming an archive, removal, reset, or other consequential action in context.
transitions.integration: Supply the real onConfirm operation. Opening only arms the control and focuses Cancel; Enter or Space cannot confirm through a held key. Cancel and Escape return to the original action before commitment. Pending operations cannot overlap or be canceled by closing the control. Rejection keeps confirmation available with an error; success persists until the host remounts for a restored or different resource. Keep resource state and restoration in the host. Without onConfirm the production control is disabled. The preview archives and restores local data only. Replay changes presentation without changing state, invoking callbacks, or moving focus.
transitions.props: onConfirm, label, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, pendingLabel, successLabel, speed, radius, className, style

adapters.name: Radix menu motion
adapters.description: Add motion to the menu you already have.
adapters.when: An existing Radix or Radix-based shadcn dropdown menu whose behavior and styles must stay host-owned.
adapters.integration: Import the CSS and opt the existing menu content into the adapter. Preserve the host's trigger, items, handlers, portal, placement, and focus behavior. Remove competing animation utilities only from the opted-in content. No UI primitives or packages are installed.

compatibility.shadcn: Use shadcn@latest; alias targets verified with 4.21.0.
compatibility.node: >=20.18.1 for shadcn 4.21.0; the portable installer supports Node >=18.
compatibility.cssTokens: Host tokens must be complete CSS colors (OKLCH, HSL, or hex), not bare HSL channels. Modern shadcn themes are supported; adapt legacy tokens locally.
compatibility.styles: Companion namespaced CSS is imported by each recipe. No Tailwind plugin, theme, or global CSS changes are declared.
